title: Welcome to the Nightcap Wiki
summary: Your field guide to a different kind of Classic adventure.
body:
Not released: The combined item/spell scaling candidate is prepared alongside pet/WPM changes. It includes selected Ascended values, additive spell damage and preserved starter progression; gameplay acceptance is still pending. See the combined candidate.

Not released: A pet and shared-scaling candidate is built for testing, including expanded pet equipment and an earned level-65/PoP profile. It is not available on the live server. The same candidate includes the WPM melee implementation: Warrior/Paladin/Monk shield damage, sustain, earned AAs and combat item effects.

Ordinary loot quality chances are now 20% Polished, 5% Exalted and 1% Ascended per eligible item drop. Loot quality details.

October 18 update: Independent AA cooldowns and item/discipline timer repairs are available for live testing. Reconnect before testing; existing waits retain their original expiry.

October 18: Classic travel archive repair is available through normal launcher Play, including West Commonlands. Close EverQuest before updating.

October 17 update: Recommended AA, 10% passive AA, no normal-death EXP loss, stacks of at least 100, three-Normal reforging and independent Monk attacks are available for live testing. Close EQ and use launcher Play.

A familiar world. Your own path.

Three classes.
One more adventure.

Find your build, learn the custom systems, and discover what is waiting beyond the tunnel.

New in Nightcap

Raid or Grind in seven private dungeons. Complete personal boss checklists for new rewards, with exclusive Raid drops. Available for live testing.

Build, craft and upgrade. Early spell scribing, stacked tradeskills and Craft All, reusable item upgrades, and equipment for your held classes are live. The normal-item box recipe is available for live testing.

Passive AA is now 10% alongside normal leveling. Read the latest changes →
